name: Praia (Cape Verde)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the city's emblem: a blue disc quartered with the skyline, a tree, waves and a pillory, ringed by gold stars and a green chain, above a scroll reading 'CIDADE DA PRAIA'.
history: The white flag with the municipal emblem was in use by 2008, the earliest photograph recorded; no adoption date has been published.

features.role: emblem of the city of Praia with stars, chain and scroll
